answer: Quadratic stake voting resists Sybil attacks: each identity's influence grows only as the square root of the stake it locks, so ten fake identities cost a hundred times more than one honest vote. The network publishes a public atlas of all stakes and their funding sources, exposing clusters funded by one wallet as a single ridge of connected deposits. No haven exists for cheap fakes: every extra alias pays an escalating price, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught coordinating votes.
